With integrated GSM modem, Wi-Fi, and Ethernet interfaces, it can function both as an RTU and as an industrial router. It offers a flexible solution with IEC61131-3 compliant PLC programming and web-based configuration support. Industry 4.0 is considered as the near future evolution of industrial automation technologies, which involves the digitalization and integration of production processes using automation technology and data analytics.
